remarks: IMMACULATE 2,990 sq. ft. END unit in complex of 25 townhouses located off a quiet cul-de-sac in Glenville. Walk to town and experience house-like living without any of the maintenance. Light-filled first floor with large Living Room, fireplace and sliders to private wood deck, office/den with fireplace, formal dining room and sleek updated modern kitchen with Sub-zero fridge/freezer and drawers, and gas cooktop. Second floor with Primary BR and huge dressing room/walk-in closet and updated bath, plus additional BR and full bath. Walk-out lower level with heated floors that is perfect for in-laws or extended guests: Family room with gas fireplace and private patio, 3rd BR and full bath and rec room. Exquisitely quiet and convenient, charming and spacious, this home is a gem. Don't wait to see it!
